title: Jill Biden says Joe Biden's prostate cancer diagnosis was "just shocking"
summary: Former first lady Jill Biden said it was "just shocking" when her husband, former President Joe Biden, was diagnosed with prostate cancer last year. When Rita Braver asked whether a White House physician should've caught it, Biden replied, "I do feel we had amazing care in the White House, but somehow that was missed." Watch more of the interview on Sunday.
